description.p: The vampiric blood within you has solidified, sharpening the predatory nature that has always lurked beneath the surface.
The ancient vampiric heritage within your blood has fully awakened, granting you the following benefits:

ul.li: Your Vampiric Bite damage die increases from a d4 to a d8.
You gain resistance to necrotic damage.
Your creature type becomes both Humanoid and Undead. You are affected by spells and abilities that target either type.

sheet.description: Your Vampiric Bite damage die increases to a d8. You have resistance to necrotic damage. You are considered both Humanoid and Undead for the purposes of spells and effects.

description.p: Faithful Companion. You always have the Find Familiar spell prepared. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot or Material components, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.
Fortified Familiar. When you cast the Find Familiar spell, your familiar's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by an amount equal to twice your character level.

Helpful Friend. When you make an ability check using a skill in which you have proficiency while your familiar is within 5 feet of you, you gain Advantage on the check. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

sheet.description: You always have Find Familiar prepared and can cast it once without a spell slot or Material components per Long Rest, or with spell slots. Your spellcasting ability is the one chosen for this feat. When you cast it, your familiar's maximum and current HP increase by twice your character level. While your familiar is within 5 feet, you can gain Advantage on a proficient skill check {{proficiency}} times per Long Rest.

description.p: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for Find Familiar.

sheet.description: Your spellcasting ability for Find Familiar is Intelligence.

description.p: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for Find Familiar.

sheet.description: Your spellcasting ability for Find Familiar is Wisdom.

description.p: Charisma is your spellcasting ability for Find Familiar.

sheet.description: Your spellcasting ability for Find Familiar is Charisma.
